results.note: The fixture sends value as the string "70". The schema types it as StrictStr (ingest/schemas.py AlternativeMeFearGreedEntry), and _parse_value turns it into an int in the range 0–100. The test asserts the result is int 70 and not a str. time_until_update is StrictStr | None = None, and test_time_until_update_is_optional_for_older_rows (line 104) covers older rows that lack it.

The disclosure is data, not a comment. It is in ALTERNATIVE_ME_SOURCE_FIELD on the Ok result and in the fear_greed_index source_field in registry.yaml. Both are asserted (lines 47 and 70). pipeline.persist_board copies result.source_field onto the persisted definition, and test_full_run_persists_fear_greed_with_disclosure_and_reference_dates asserts the persisted source_field. The web cell face renders sourceField (web/src/DatapointValue.tsx:65; CellFace.test.tsx:145 asserts it is visible).

The test asserts the exact phrase 'surveys 15% currently paused' in the fetcher's source_field. The same phrase is asserted in the registry test (line 70) and in the persisted-row test in tests/test_persist_board.py, so the disclosure does not present all six weights as live.

The attribution 'Data provided by alternative.me' is asserted in the fetcher source_field, the registry entry (line 70) and the persisted datapoint (test_full_run_persists_fear_greed_with_disclosure_and_reference_dates). It reaches the UI through the generic sourceField rendering (DatapointValue.tsx:65, CellDetail.tsx:56). No web test checks this particular cell's attribution text.

All three new models (entry, metadata, response) set ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True). The test asserts that an added field fails with extra_forbidden, a renamed field fails, and a retyped value fails with string_type. test_malformed_response_becomes_fetch_failed_error (line 120) checks that a malformed response becomes Error(FETCH_FAILED).

The fetcher is now wired into the pipeline: pipeline.run_all_assets selects registry entries with response_model alternative_me_fear_greed, and its default fetcher calls alternative_me.fetch_fear_greed_index, which does an httpx.get to the real URL. persist_board handles AlternativeMeFearGreedOk. The live test drives run_all_assets(tier='daily') with no injected fetcher, so it goes through the assembled board to the real endpoint. Offline, test_scheduled_daily_tier and the heartbeat.main entry-point tests show the cell is persisted once. Caveat: the test is marked integration and deselected by default (pyproject addopts), so no gate executed it and there is no recorded live pass.
The US-806-C7 gate `uv run pytest -q` exited 0 (336 passed, 56 deselected). The combined test gate, including 53 web tests, and mypy --strict also exited 0.

note: The work looks real, not faked: the tests assert concrete values, disclosure phrases and schema rejections. Most of the churn in the count tests follows from adding one registry entry.
